bio: I'm **Benosh Benoy**, a Computer Science student building at the intersection of code, design, and AI, currently studying at **Mar Baselios College of Engineering and Technology**.

I live where engineering meets aesthetics — writing code that works and interfaces that feel right. From Python tools to AI experiments to UI case studies, I care about the craft end to end, and I think about products strategically, not just visually.

facts.body: Regression models trained across multiple projects.
Multiple hackathons — prototypes shipped under deadline.

items.title: BQuick
items.description: An adaptive browser typing trainer that measures dwell and flight time for every keystroke, identifies weak key-to-key transitions, and turns them into focused drills.

items.title: BeMag
items.description: A browser arcade — a galaxy-themed front page and four game cabinets, one of them built. Emoji Bounce is a canvas keepy-uppy game where the paddle tracks your cursor and the screen shifts colour as you climb through star thresholds.

items.title: Student Report Analyser
items.description: A desktop tool that ingests student marksheets and turns them into clear, actionable performance insights — trends, weak areas, and printable summaries through a clean GUI.

items.title: Personal Budget Tracker
items.description: A friendly budgeting app to log expenses, set category limits, and visualise where the money actually goes — with charts that make overspending obvious.

items.title: Google Pay Mobile App Redesign
items.description: An end-to-end UX case study reimagining the Google Pay flow — research, wireframes, and a polished high-fidelity prototype focused on clarity and trust.
